pairs.a: The walled city on the eastern plain was prepared to resist.
pairs.b: The walled city on the eastern plain was prepared to surrender.

pairs.a: On the last cold evening of November, the weary garrison seemed ready to resist.
pairs.b: On the last cold evening of November, the weary garrison seemed ready to surrender.

pairs.a: Thunder rolled over the wall as freezing rain fell, and the men on it had no wish to resist.
pairs.b: Thunder rolled over the wall as freezing rain fell, and the men on it had no wish to surrender.

pairs.a: Beside the candle on the table lay a folded letter urging the household to resist.
pairs.b: Beside the candle on the table lay a folded letter urging the household to surrender.

pairs.a: Three merchants standing near the fountain were quietly deciding whether to resist.
pairs.b: Three merchants standing near the fountain were quietly deciding whether to surrender.
